title: The Importance of Tarbiyah and Akhlaq for Children

text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of tarbiyah (upbringing) for children upon religious and moral values, and highlights the necessity of reinforcing positive behavior in them. It also clarifies that neglect in guidance may lead to behavioral issues. Parents must follow up with their children and provide continuous advice and direction.

review_defects.english: The Importance of Tarbiyah and Akhlaq for Children
review_defects.why: The English title omits 'religious' (الدينية) and converts the adjectival phrase 'religious and moral upbringing' into two nouns 'Tarbiyah and Akhlaq', losing the explicit religious dimension and altering the meaning.
